 The Bruins  (8-2-1) will face the Sharks (6-4-1) in an early-season rematch on Saturday night.
 Boston is coming off a 6-0 win over Nashville in which Michael DiPietro posted his first career shutout. David Pastrnak paced the Bruins with four points (two goals, two assists), and Charlie McAvoy added four assists.
 WATCH:
 Bruins vs. Sharks LIVE on Fubo (free trial) 
 The Sharks will be ending their two-week road trip with a visit to Boston, looking to secure a third straight win. They fell to the Bruins on Oct. 13.
 Here is everything you need to know about Bruins vs. Sharks, including TV and streaming options for the game.
 How to watch Bruins vs. Sharks tonight: TV channel, live stream
 TV channel:  NESN
 Live stream:   NESN 360 , Fubo 
 Bruins vs. Sharks will air on NESN. The game will also be available to stream on NESN 360  and Fubo .

 Bruins vs. Sharks date, start time
 Date: Saturday, Oct. 24
 Time: 7 p.m. ET
 Bruins vs. Sharks is scheduled to start at 7 p.m. ET on Saturday, Oct. 24. The game will be played at TD Garden in Boston.
